key.name: panel-enable
key.description: When enabled, the panel applies beautification effects

key.name: panel-bgopacity
key.description: Opacity of the panel background, 0 = fully transparent, 100 = fully opaque

key.name: panel-bgcolor-enable
key.description: When enabled, the panel background uses the color specified below

key.name: panel-bgcolor-color
key.description: Panel background color in hexadecimal format, e.g. #000000 or #1c1c1c

key.name: panel-fgcolor-enable
key.description: When enabled, the panel text uses the color specified below

key.name: panel-fgcolor-color
key.description: Panel text color in hexadecimal format, e.g. #ffffff or #ececec

key.name: clock-enable
key.description: When enabled, the panel clock uses the custom format specified

key.name: clock-format
key.description: Custom clock format using strftime-style specifiers, e.g. %Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S or %H:%M
